data.name: Production Distro RC planning shape
data.description: Each RC milestone uses a workflow-session.json, plan.json, .task task specs, docs, evidence, and state pointer update.
data.usage: RC11 planning follows this shape and advances current_task to RC11-001.

data.risk: external endpoint reachability mistaken for trust
data.mitigation: Require descriptor hash, drift-zero, quarantine fetch verification, public signature, revocation, compatibility, rollback, exact approval, AgentCore, and SecurityExecution evidence before any effect.

data.naming: Production Distro tasks use RCNN-NNN identifiers and artifacts named by task intent.
data.imports: PowerShell scripts remain standalone and local-first.
data.formatting: JSON workflow files use stable object keys and explicit false invariants for authority boundaries.
